name: Salesforce Platform Limits Reference for Org Strategy
description: Comprehensive Salesforce platform limits that inform org strategy decisions. Use during capacity planning and when evaluating whether a single org can support the customer's scale.
source: Org Strategy And Design — Salesforce Life Sciences

org_strategy_thresholds.description: Key thresholds that should trigger multi-org evaluation when exceeded.

users_per_org.note: Above 5K users, evaluate multi-org. Performance, governance, and change management all degrade.

records_per_entity.note: Above 10M records per entity per org. High-volume modules at risk: Events Management, Activity Plans, Sample transactions.

field_count_risk.note: Objects with 200+ fields cause sync/bulk API/UI performance degradation.

mobile_record_types.note: 100+ record types in a single profile hits mobile metadata limits.

limit_types.description: Three categories of limits for org strategy evaluation.

soft_limits.description: Can be worked around with architecture or process changes.
examples: API call volume (batch instead of real-time)

hard_limits.description: Cannot be overcome by features — only by org splitting, which gives a fresh set of limits.
examples: Record type count in mobile profiles

purchasable_limits.description: Can be increased by purchasing additional capacity.
